string.text: A rather fancy Western card. Like other credit cards, it has complex fraud protection, but its owners often make pointless purchases, so it should be easy to walk away with a large amount of money. They will not mind, anyway. Better to secure your survival than let the money go toward another bottle of champagne or an escort.
A bank card stolen from some poor stalker. In the Zone, large purchases are sometimes made electronically for safety. It is an ordinary card, so there is probably not much money in the account.\n
A credit card from an international credit company. These cards have decent fraud protection, but a small, clever trick might let you withdraw some money before the owner finds out.
A thick bundle of money. It is enough to make you someone’s target.\n
A large bundle of rubles. It is worth quite a bit. Did someone rob a bank?\n
A small bundle of banknotes, probably taken from the cash register of some grocery store. It is unlikely to be worth much.\n
A medium-sized bundle of rubles with a moderate to large amount of money. The banknotes are still crisp.\n
